summary: The question and admission threshold are properly framed around actual-family Profile A/B exclusions and a conditional global implication. The frozen receipts support admission to substantive review, while their cached-dependency limitations prevent a stronger source-rebuild conclusion at this phase. The manuscript clearly distinguishes local formal results, an ordinary corollary using external I27, and unproved exploratory cap45 diagnostics.

findings.disposition: Admission is methodologically justified for review; this is not yet a full proof or source-closure audit.
